tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App ground behind every screen and the tab bar. Midnight slate, deliberately not black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, control tiles, list groups and the segmented control track, sitting on bg.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Selected segment, progress track, pressed tile, action sheet groups.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows inside a surface and the top edge of the tab bar.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-2 (15:1 on bg).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: device names, times, sizes, footnotes, inactive tabs. On bg, surface and surface-2 (at least 5.6:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Plex amber, the one accent: progress fills, the active control tile fill, the selected tab, toggle-on, tile icons, focus ring. As text on bg or surface (8:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (9:1).

tokens.name: on-accent-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on an accent fill, e.g. a tile's state line (5:1).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success state only: seed rule met, service running. Always paired with a word (gata, pornit). On bg or surface (6.9:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive only: shut down, restart, a service that is down. Icon, outline or text; a filled red is reserved for the final confirm in the action sheet. On bg or surface (5.3:1).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (the confirm row in the action sheet).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the action sheet and the PIN error state.

tokens.name: backdrop-scrim
tokens.usage: Over the blurred backdrop in NowPlayingCard; keeps ink and muted text at 4.5:1 or more.

styles.name: title-screen
styles.usage: One per screen, at the top: Acasă, Filme, PC.

styles.name: countdown
styles.usage: The shutdown countdown number only. Tabular figures.

styles.name: title-card
styles.usage: The movie title in the now-playing card and the action sheet heading.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Section headers, row titles, button labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: PC-ul se oprește la 60 de secunde după confirmare.

styles.name: tile-label
styles.usage: Control tile labels and list row titles.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Secondary lines in muted: device, release note, footnotes under a group.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Times, sizes, ratios and percentages. Always tabular figures and Romanian decimal commas.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Tab bar labels under their icons.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a progress bar and its data line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between poster cards in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of the now-playing card; gap between control tiles; poster to text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter; inner padding of tiles and list groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space above the tab bar at the end of a scroll and around the PIN pad.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Poster badges and mini posters (40px wide).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Poster cards in the grid.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Segmented control track, buttons, toast.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, control tiles, list groups.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Action sheet top corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, progress bars, toggles, PIN keys.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The action sheet only. Nothing else casts a shadow.

tokens.name: size-tap
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything tappable.

tokens.name: size-tile
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a control tile.

tokens.name: size-poster-hero
tokens.usage: Poster width in the now-playing card.

tokens.name: size-poster-mini
tokens.usage: Poster width in compact rows (downloads, waiting).

tokens.name: size-key
tokens.usage: PIN pad key diameter.

tokens.name: size-content
tokens.usage: Maximum content width; centred on tablets.
